summary: The Somewhere Co. is a Brisbane (Newstead) lifestyle brand selling through retail, wholesale, marketplaces and eCommerce across three brands. Its finance team (Finance Manager Crystal Thornton, Accountant Jonathan Fletcher, offshore Bookkeeper Melanie Ragudos) runs daily Cin7-into-Xero closes and bank recs per its own job ads, and a Group Finance Manager role has been advertised.

hooks.text: Own job ad describes the exact workload: daily Cin7-into-Xero close and channel revenue recs.
Three brands across several channels feeding Xero makes payout/revenue recs a close bottleneck; new Group Finance Manager hire signals a process-tightening window.

risks.text: Only Melanie Ragudos (offshore bookkeeper) has a verified email; the Finance Manager (Crystal Thornton, the buyer) has none, so outreach goes to the day-to-day user and asks to be pointed to Crystal.
Group Finance Manager role may be filled/changing; finance leadership may shift.

gaps: No podcasts, blog posts or press quotes from finance staff found.
Could not confirm whether the Group Finance Manager role has been filled.

first.subject: Cin7 into Xero at The Somewhere Co.
first.body:
Hi Melanie,

The Somewhere Co.'s Finance Officer ad from last year describes a daily close of Cin7 into Xero, plus month-end revenue reconciliations with channel allocations. That is a lot of matching across retail, wholesale and online, and I can see you are Xero certified, so you probably know it well. I built Vert to turn hours of reconciliation into minutes, with a trace behind every match so nothing is guessed. Who owns channel revenue recs at month-end today, and would a short look at how Vert handles them be useful?

Best,
Dawoud
